precedence: parse reports the narrowest token or production failure
semantic validation reports identity and reference failures only after parsing succeeds for that construct
capability diagnostics apply only to semantically valid authored meaning
layout diagnostics apply only after parsing, semantic validation, and capability admission succeed

namespaces.codes: Graph-interchange diagnostics and operation findings; coral.* codes retain their published identities.
namespaces.sourceCodes: Saved-source and header diagnostics; header.* and coral.* source findings have distinct reader contracts. Header diagnostics carry ranges rather than severity.
namespaces.consumerCodes: Diagnostics emitted after the saved-source readers: symbol resolution, artwork admission, rendering and GraphIR interchange. Each names the file that emits it or, while planned, its delivery step.
